paras: Paracontias hildebrandti, also known commonly as Hildebrand's skink and Hildebrandt's skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Madagascar.
The specific name, hildebrandti, is in honor of German botanist Johann Maria Hildebrandt.
P. hildebrandti is found in northern Madagascar, including the island of Nosy Be.
The preferred natural habitat of P. hildebrandti is forest, at altitudes from sea level to 1,500 m (4,900 ft), but it may also be found in disturbed areas such as cacao plantations.
P. hildebrandti has no legs, and it has no external ear openings.
